content.text: UP Ayush Counselling is the state counselling conducted by the Department of Ayush, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh , for admission to Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy courses. The primary qualification for participation in the counselling is the NEET-UG examination. Candidates who qualified the NEET-UG examination of the current year can apply to both private and government BAMS/BHMS/BUMS colleges in Uttar Pradesh through the State Quota or All India Quota.
NEET-UG 2025 was held on 4 May 2025, and the results were published on 14 June 2025. The UP Ayush Counselling dates have not yet been published officially by the authorities.
This article delves into the details of Uttar Pradesh Ayush Counselling, including fees, cutoff, eligibility, and counselling process.

The Department of Ayush, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow , is in charge of conducting the UP Ayush Counselling for both UG and PG Ayush courses. Both private and government Ayurveda, Homeopathy, and Unani institutions, recognized by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and National Commission for Homeopathy (NCH), participate in the counselling. There are 80 BAMS colleges , 13 BHMS colleges, and 13 BUMS colleges in the state.

The NEET-UG examination conducted by the NTA serves as the primary criterion for admission to the Ayush courses. The NEET-UG qualified candidates with an academic background of higher secondary education in the science stream must register with the UP Ayush Counselling official website at https://upayushcounseling.upsdc.gov.in/ to participate in the counselling.

The State reserves 85% of the seats under the State Quota only for the domicile students of Uttar Pradesh, and the remaining 15% seats are under the All India Quota (AIQ) , open to all candidates, including non-domicile/ students from other states.
